change: Snapshot any located hit origin on damage; use that snapshot for the unchanged1.1second indicator. Cover after a hit or later attacker movement/defeat cannot move or erase it. No current enemy tracking or identity is inferred. Located environmental blasts may supply direction; unlocated damage clears it. Live enemy threat markers retain existing visibility/range/history rules.
